selectionFrames.label: Complete 2024 Kindle Storyteller Award shortlist

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2026 Selfies Book Awards fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all six fiction titles on the official 2026 Selfies results page, with no provider-result filtering. The award FAQ limits the 2026 prize to English-language books self-published during 2025.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Penguin Random House stand-alone science fiction and fantasy list observed 2026-09-04
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all sixteen titles present on the publisher list at the observation date, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Hachette standalone books for romantasy fans list observed 2026-09-04
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all eight titles under the publisher's standalone heading at the observation date, including any label contradicted by stronger current relational evidence, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Hachette standalone SFF horror section observed 2026-09-06
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all nine titles under the publisher list's Horror heading at the observation date, including ambiguous labels and any label contradicted by stronger current relational evidence, with no provider-result filtering.
